name: Canonical Master Records State Transition Custody
purpose: Submit each observed governed state transition receipt and every required evidence artifact resulting from that transition to the existing Master Records custody/reconstruction authority; require exact validation and reconstruction of the receipt plus the complete required-evidence set before machine-owned progression continues, without promoting custody into transition authority.
trigger: a governed state transition decision, execution consequence, denial, failure, partial outcome, or fail-closed state has been observed
scope: one observed governed state transition receipt plus its complete required evidence manifest
reuse_instructions: Use this for the canonical per-state-transition custody consequence. Every transition receipt must declare required_evidence_manifest, even when empty. Every additional required evidence artifact produced by the transition must be included with exact content, transition binding, encoding, and SHA-256; Master Records must validate and reconstruct the complete set before progression. Task-specific probes may compare conformance but must not replace this path. Specialized lane validators may produce semantic validation artifacts, but those artifacts themselves must enter the required evidence manifest. Interlock/InTr remains transition authority and TV/TVC remains credential authority where required.
